name: Single Implant
description: One implant fixture replacing a single missing tooth, including surgical placement.

name: Multiple Implants
description: Two or more independent implants placed to replace several missing teeth, priced per fixture with a bulk-placement discount.

name: Implant-Supported Bridge
description: A fixed bridge of 3+ replacement teeth anchored by 2 implants, closing multiple gaps without an implant per tooth.

name: Implant-Supported Denture (Overdenture)
description: A removable full-arch denture that snaps onto 4 implants for stability, a lower-cost alternative to a fixed full-arch bridge.

name: All-on-4
description: A full arch of teeth fixed permanently onto 4 strategically angled implants — one of the most requested full-arch protocols.

name: All-on-6
description: A full arch fixed onto 6 implants for added support, often recommended for patients with reduced bone density.

name: All-on-8
description: A full arch fixed onto 8 implants, maximizing long-term load distribution for complex cases.

name: Full Mouth Restoration (Both Arches)
description: Full-arch implant restoration of both the upper and lower jaw in a single coordinated treatment plan.
